reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 0. This weekend, I was honored to join advocates, families, and community members as we recognized World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims, including constituents from PA05.

Our transportation policies and spending should reflect the value of human lives. My office has worked hard to secure grants to implement traffic calming and pedestrian safety projects on Cobbs Creek Parkway and MacDade Blvd, and I have introduced the Pedestrian Protection Act to improve vehicle safety standards for pedestrians and bicyclists.

I joined Fairmont Park Conservancy, state and city officials, friends, and neighbors at Stephen Girard Park for a clean up and tree planting to celebrate Love Your Parks Weekend. We were able to replant some of the trees that were toppled in last summer’s microburst!  Such a https://t.co/qN908LwaFp

Modern public libraries are community centers and sources of all kinds of information! Book clubs, quilting, and canasta are just a few of the reasons why the Haverford Township Library has seen attendance soar. I secured $2 million for the library’s redevelopment in FY23, and

The GOP has decided to mark Veterans Day by trying to pass legislation that would CUT $57 billion from veterans’ benefits over the next 10 years, affecting up to 1.5 million veterans. Yesterday I met with a representative from the Pennsylvania VFW, which has expressed strong opposition to the bill.

House Democrats plan to rectify this insult by forcing a vote this week to approve the Major Richard Star Act, which would ensure that combat-injured veterans receive full benefits.
We'd prefer to work out bipartisan solutions, but it takes two to tango. https://t.co/XZUgpLu9ej

Today, we honor the courage, dedication, and sacrifice of all who have honorably served our country. On Veterans Day and every day, we must honor the service and sacrifice of our veterans and their families by ensuring that they receive the care, benefits, and opportunities they have earned.
As the daughter of a Marine, happy birthday to the US Marine Corps! https://t.co/gVIjqzA83R

Wishing a very happy Diwali to all who celebrate! May the Festival of Lights bring joy, peace, prosperity, and new beginnings to you and your loved ones. Wishing all of our neighbors celebrating a bright and beautiful holiday!

Today's ribbon-cutting was a real testament to the power of cooperation and determination among our federal, state, and local partners.

Congratulations, Ridley Park!
